nanning-2017.notes: The 13 Luogu pages (P17211-P17223) show Chinese machine translations ('翻译由 DeepSeek V4 Pro 完成', fānyì yóu DeepSeek V4 Pro wánchéng, 'translation done by DeepSeek V4 Pro') as raw Markdown; samples and limits are not in the visible page. Pages C, D, H and K refer to images on cdn.luogu.com.cn that our copies do not hold.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a QOJ login page; our copy has since been replaced and is now the contest's dashboard with its 13 problems.
